text: Willy whispered as the sun blinked in, I bet that you would never see so bad. Oh, well, you don't know, never mind, I do, Have the soft and little bird on Ellie's hand. Autumn came along, Love, young dreamer, all, We'll wait round to fall, Serve and with a drink, take a cheap shot,
